tool_signatures.description: Check health of in-flight PRs (outbound PR heartbeat).

save_snapshot.description: Persist the result to data/status-snapshots/ and diff it against the previous snapshot (default True — the dashboard's memory is the point of this tool). Frequent polling is safe: a snapshot is written when state changes and at most once a day when it does not, so the directory cannot flood.
